notes:
First published build of VP Studio.

This release exists mainly to establish the update channel: any installation from 0.31 onward checks this feed once a day and offers new versions. Earlier builds have no update checker, so they must be updated by hand once.

Recent work in this build:

- Batch printing and sort breaks. Break every N pieces, or on a marked field from your address sorter, using a relay pulse or an inserted blank piece. The separator method is a machine setting; jobs follow it unless they override it.
- Copies from Windows applications. Word renders its own copies rather than asking the printer for them, so a 3-copy job arrived as three identical pages. VP Studio now recognises that and shows it as one piece with a copy count, instead of multiplying whatever you type in the placement window.
- High-dpi displays. The whole main window now scales correctly at any Windows display scale from 100% to 300%. Every build is checked automatically at eight scales before it can be released.
- Collapsible sections on the Print page, remembered per machine.
- Clearer errors. A refused or failed print now says what actually went wrong instead of showing an internal error code.
- Installer: a Detect printer button, so plugging the printer in after setup has started no longer means restarting it.
- Ink profile editing, Unload Data, alignment and ordering tools on the design page, and a warning when the printer's pen setup has changed since the last run.
